newsitem.title: UK: UK shares firm at close, underpinned by Wall St.
newsitem.headline: UK shares firm at close, underpinned by Wall St.

text.p: UK shares were firm at the close on Wednesday, underpinned by fresh gains in the Dow and U.S. Treasury bonds but well below the day's early record amid caution ahead of Thursday's election.
After touching a record 4,466.5 in early trade, the FTSE 100 coasted lower for much of the day to close up just 2.8 points at 4,436.0 -- short of the record close of 4,444.3 set on March 11.

Dealers said the market had largely shrugged off Tuesday's 179-point surge on Wall Street, its biggest point rise in ten years, and might wait until Friday for a post-election "relief rally" once the election result was known.
